entities.summary: Naik Muhammad Mahfuz was a Pakistani military officer and the ninth recipient of Pakistan's highest military award, Nishan-e-Haider. He was posthumously awarded for his gallant and valorous actions during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971.He was born in Janjua muslim rajput family.
